title: FastFill新增最近邻：轻量房间布局方法的创新边界
scope: 只读2024–2026代表最近邻；主任务为真实空壳＋指定文字家具清单、未知尺寸→完整布局→共同RoomGenBench。沿用上一轮14篇审计，不重复评估框架调研。不声称穷尽新颖性检索。
retrieval: 检索arXiv正文、作者项目页、官方GitHub；3个可定位仓库用git ls-remote HEAD固定commit，只下载少量文本。未改项目、未安装、未调用付费模型或跑生成。

papers.name: LayoutVLM
papers.title: LayoutVLM: Differentiable Optimization of 3D Layout via Vision-Language Models
papers.official_proof: 论文链接作者Stanford页；该作者GitHub README回链作者项目和同篇CVPR2025引用；上轮SceneEval官方README亦指定此仓库。本次Stanford live fetch超时，不能据此说项目消失。
papers.read_level: 论文§4、§5.1、A.2/A.3及官方README/main和布局调用关键段。

paper_facts.facts: Given actual 3D assets and floor boundaries, a VLM predicts poses plus differentiable relations: distance, on-top, alignment, pointing and wall attachment. Visual marks supply scale and front directions. Self-consistency retains relations compatible with proposed poses; it is not ordinary majority voting. Adam with boundary projection runs 400 steps. For 40 assets the paper reports 1–5 GPU minutes and 5–10 GPT-4o calls, roughly one per group. Evaluation uses 33 cases across 11 room types, up to 80 assets, common preprocessed assets, CF/IB and GPT-4o positional/rotational coherence; PSA weights semantic rating by physical validity. Missing placements receive random placements. This tests asset-given arrangement, not unknown-size inventory generation.

code_facts.claim: 官方main当前固定mode='one_shot'；论文分组预算和此CLI默认模式要区分。one_shot仍有可微优化，不能等于纯GPT一次直接坐标。
实际布局代码存在one_shot/group模式、程序解析/执行重试；调用预算必须含失败重试，未实测API次数。
README要求实际asset mesh/boundingBox；未给尺寸的文字家具清单需另做尺寸/asset入口。

already_covered: 分组布局与自一致关系过滤
papers.limitations_for_our_task: 已知asset几何比主榜多信息；代理几何与真实可用性仍须分别检查。主表的VLM观感及PSA不能替代精确清单/尺度约束。关系过滤依赖初始化，可排掉真实但初始pose未满足的要求（机制推论，非独立实验）。
papers.implication: 不能把“加关系图/加梯度solver/画front箭头”单独当新意；它是必要强基线。直接GPT输出若已更好，应先确认我们解码或repair是否降低语义质量，而不是默认堆更多反馈轮次。
papers.reproduction_limit: 未运行仓库、权重、评估或API，未验证论文计时；官方README不是全部实验可复现证明。

papers.name: PhyScene
papers.title: PhyScene: Physically Interactable 3D Scene Synthesis for Embodied AI
papers.official_proof: 作者项目Code链接与官方仓库互链。

paper_facts.facts: Floor-conditioned diffusion predicts layout and shape features; guidance handles collisions, boundaries and agent reachability. A* paths between walkable components produce agent boxes for gradient penalties. Articulated assets use expanded motion envelopes. Evaluation reports CAD-mesh collision object/scene rates, outside-object rate, random-start object reachability, largest-component/free-space ratio and FID/KID/SCA/CKL. Guidance uses bbox proxies while finer occupancy evaluation is considered separately. The authors report occupancy-gated guidance as 55 times slower and warn that optimizing size for feasibility shrinks objects; guidance therefore updates position/orientation. No per-scene API budget applies to its learned denoiser; exact total inference latency was not verified here.

code_facts.claim: 官方launcher显式生成1000场景，开启floor condition，overlap_type='mesh'；统计实现与具体mesh remeshing仍未逐行重审。
README给geometry生成、render、FID/KID/SCA入口，存在实际公开仓库；不能仅据此声称所有数值已复现。

already_covered: agent宽度适配与连通通道引导
papers.limitations_for_our_task: 标准输入是floor-conditioned分布采样，不原生严格遵从逐对象开放文字清单；含多步diffusion及资产检索，不是一次布局前向。碰撞、边界、通行目标会相互冲突，不能只优化一项再称全部提高。
papers.implication: 可借鉴代理检查与尺度防作弊。若我们预测未知尺寸，要同时报尺度合理性，防止repair/训练通过缩家具换低碰撞。不能把“补可通行loss/门柜可打开”笼统当首次创新。
papers.reproduction_limit: 只核公开文本与launcher；未取模型、未跑CAD碰撞、A*或仿真。

papers.name: RoboLayout
papers.title: RoboLayout: Differentiable 3D Scene Generation for Embodied Agents
papers.official_proof: 论文首页脚注直接给该作者仓库。
papers.evidence_weight: 机制的先前公开证据；效果证据较弱，不能与有量化大规模benchmark的方法视为同等级。

paper_facts.facts: Extends LayoutVLM with planar robot-radius clearance and selective cleanup. Reachability is a pairwise center-distance penalty using half the smaller footprint dimension as object radius, not motion planning. Cleanup freezes acceptable objects and optimizes overlapping movable objects; an example budget is 40 cleanup steps. Experiments describe GPT-4o, 5–10 objects, qualitative layouts and loss curves; no broad quantitative benchmark or measured API/latency advantage was found in the inspected section. Full motion planning and vertical reach are explicitly future work.

code_facts.claim: one_shot是单组布局；名为finetuned的模式是LLM先分组再逐组摆放，不能据模式名说做了模型权重微调。
robot_radius默认.3m；实际输入读取已处理asset metadata和bbox尺寸。
README自述每组只要一个constraint program，解析/执行失败重试；不是多个候选majority-vote。

already_covered: 只修违规物体并冻结其余
papers.limitations_for_our_task: 实际asset/尺寸已给；圆盘两两间距不是门口可达或操作可行证明。公开实验支撑有限，不宜借其描述推出性能确定优于LayoutVLM。
papers.implication: “轻量局部repair”本身已有公开近邻；若采用，只能把更好的错误定位、未知尺寸一致性及实测质量/延迟收益作为待验证贡献。
papers.reproduction_limit: 未运行代码；未核精确全局优化步数/请求次数和wall-clock。

papers.name: LayoutDreamer
papers.title: LAYOUTDREAMER: Physics-guided Layout for Text-to-3D Compositional Scene Generation
papers.date_and_status: 首发2025-02-04，已读arXiv v2 2025-03-22；arXiv登记Pattern Recognition 178 (2026), 113427。
papers.official_code_status: 本次针对性搜索及原论文中未找到可确认的官方公开GitHub；不能据此断言永不公开。ThreeStudio/GaussianDreamer是依赖，不是LayoutDreamer官方实现。
papers.read_level: 论文§3.1–3.4、§4.1–4.2；arXiv元数据确认年份和期刊版。

paper_facts.facts: Text becomes a directed graph guiding disentangled 3D Gaussians. Gravity, nonpenetration, anchors and semantic layout energies optimize poses after object generation. It uses Llama3-8B and GaussianDreamer; one object requires 2000 optimization iterations. A three-object, fifteen-constraint layout example converges in 300 steps. Section 4.1 reports roughly twenty minutes per asset and total time 21M+2 choose(M,2) minutes, whereas the conclusion says layout within fifteen minutes; these are different/incompletely aligned scopes. Evaluation follows T3Bench quality/text alignment, not a floor-shell exact-inventory room benchmark.

already_covered: 物理能量＋语义能量分阶段权衡
可编辑、解耦多对象场景
papers.limitations_for_our_task: 这是组合text-to-3D生成，不是只做空壳家具布局；资产优化成本很重。T3Bench高分不证明固定inventory、门窗或真实房间边界满足。不可把结尾15分钟当端到端耗时，也不可把能量代理叫真实刚体稳定性。
papers.implication: 可引用以限制“关系图＋物理loss”的新颖性，但不建议移植3DGS生成pipeline。我们的轻量下游后续由用户提供，应保持模块边界。
papers.reproduction_limit: 未找到官方源码，未运行；2026期刊全文相对arXiv变更未逐项核。

hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.idea: 先保留强一次生成作为可检验上界，再定位我们丢失质量的阶段。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.status: 实验建议，不是新颖性主张。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.minimum_test: 同一request/shell、同样有无尺寸/asset信息、相同decode后处理和下游；保存一次生成原布局、我们raw、我们remask后、我们repair后。分别量inventory/size/关系/几何/人评及latency，找出下降从哪一步开始。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.failure_criterion: 若我们在相同信息和预算下各项均被一次生成支配，当前方法没有质量-成本优势；先修模型/目标/推理，不包装pipeline创新。

hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.idea: 学习从文字清单联合预测尺度和布局，在严格固定延迟/步数内逼近强单次GPT。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.status: 研究假设；蒸馏/直接布局并非新概念，须对NaLA/SceneNAT及其他近期直接方法比较。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.minimum_test: 只用既有离线teacher outputs或人工可行替代；对单参考pose监督与可行替代监督做小规模对比，报告同质量所需成本和有效率，而不是只报更低GT坐标误差。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.failure_criterion: 尺度被缩小、语义关系降低，或必须多次昂贵VLM回路才能追平，则不支持轻量主张。

hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.idea: 针对实际下游尺度/前向约定的不确定性做小预算适配。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.status: 工程和研究分开；普通asset-layout alignment/repair已有前人，不是首次。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.minimum_test: 待用户提供轻量workflow后，固定inventory不变，对实际mesh尺寸/语义front变化分层测交付前后失真；只改少数变量且预先限定预算，与共同deterministic repair比较。
hypotheses_for_a_lightweight_method.failure_criterion: 收益来自更多asset检索/更多API调用或更宽松评估而非布局机制，则不能当模型创新。

conclusions: 强一次GPT领先时，最有价值的工作是找出当前学习目标、remask或几何repair导致的具体损失，并建立可重复的质量/成本对照。文献已经覆盖关系图、critic、多agent、physical guidance和局部cleanup；轻量是需要实测的约束，不是增加agent数量。
